'''''Nirama: Hand of Fate''''' was a documentary that was made during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], about the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]].

==History==
The documentary was recorded in a warehouse on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. As part of it [[Nadin Paal]], an associate of Nirama, and the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who worked for the Oblee on a number of occasions, were all interviewed.
